intro.text: The leader of a band of deserters chasing Shallan's caravan, who scoffs at her offer of amnesty until she talks him into helping fight off bandits.
The leader of a band of army deserters preying on caravans near the Shattered Plains, who reluctantly joins Shallan Davar's caravan.
A former deserter who, pardoned at Shallan Davar's request, now leads her guards.
A former deserter in Shallan Davar's service, now training as a spy.
A former deserter who is now a Lightweaver of Shallan Davar's Unseen Court, bonded to the Cryptic Mosaic.

items.text: Little is known of Vathah's early life, though he never had what he would call a real family. He held many jobs, including a stint as a sailor.

Vathah served in Torol Sadeas's army on the Shattered Plains and thought himself a good soldier, until something broke in him. Seeing the war's purpose shift from avenging King Gavilar to collecting gemhearts, he felt that what he'd been fighting for was a sham, came to regret his actions and deserted.

Vathah led about twenty-five deserters who preyed on caravans travelling to and from the Plains. When Shallan Davar came to them for help against bandits attacking another caravan, most of his men were swayed by her speech and charged. Vathah, who hadn't taken her seriously, followed in the end, and executed the last bandit after the fight.

Angry at losing seven men in a fight he felt couldn't redeem them, Vathah confronted Shallan and grew threatening until he was distracted. He didn't believe she could do anything for them once they reached the warcamps.

On the road, Tyn learned that Vathah carried a bounty of four emerald broams. When Pattern called Vathah's men to help Shallan, they fought their way in and found her standing over Tyn's body with a Shardblade. From then on, Vathah accepted Shallan as his master.
As head of Shallan's guard, Vathah announced her as she sought out Dalinar Kholin in the warcamps. When she came out of her meeting with the king, she handed him a writ of pardon.

Housed in Sebarial's warcamp, Vathah was paid but had little to do. He and Gaz hunted for a copy of Words of Radiance, finding one only on the day Shallan set out with the expedition to Narak. On the march, Vathah and the others guarded Shallan proudly and competently.

In Urithiru, with little to do, Vathah grew lax. At Adolin's suggestion, Shallan, as Veil, set Vathah's men to hunting for a strange copier of violence in the Breakaway market. When it struck, Vathah ran to fetch Veil, but she outran him and faced it alone.

Another day, Veil visited the barracks and asked Ishnah, a would-be spy, to train Vathah and his men. Vathah threw himself into the lessons; after an hour he could observe, memorise and describe the people in the room.
Shallan took Vathah, Ishnah and Red on the expedition to Kholinar, where she showed them she was also Veil. Vathah hadn't guessed, but took it in stride.

To attract the attention of the Cult of Moments, the team stole food from Nananav's larder, with Vathah disguised by Shallan's illusion as her assistant. He admitted being nervous but liking it, and nearly panicked when Nananav closed the gates on them.

Guided by Ishnah, Vathah began planning operations himself, including a robbery of a mausoleum's larder. When an innkeeper startled him, he accidentally drew in Stormlight and wrapped himself in an illusion of his chosen alias. Veil told him he was likely becoming her squire, and he grew emotional.
After the theft went off without a hitch, Vathah drove Veil to the Oathgate platform and waited nearby in case she needed to escape, then briefed Elhokar on what she had learned.

Vathah bonded a Cryptic named Mosaic and became a full Lightweaver. With other agents of the Unseen Court, he helped Shallan track down Ialai Sadeas in the old warcamps, but Ialai died of poison in front of him; he identified it as blackbane.
Shallan came to suspect a spy among the Unseen Court, and Vathah ranked high on her list. He was eager to join the mission to Lasting Integrity, and she decided to take him.

Tested by Jasnah, Vathah Soulcast obsidian into lavis pulp, enough to join the delegation to Shadesmar. On the voyage he worked alongside the peakspren crew. When Shallan drew him out, they spoke of wanting to Lightweave themselves into someone new, and she told him the Unseen Court cared for him.

At Nameless, Vathah and Shallan scouted in disguise as spren, and Shallan concluded with relief that he wasn't the spy. After the delegation rescued a group of spren from human attackers, Vathah quietly pocketed spheres from the dead. At Lasting Integrity he camped outside with the other agents through Adolin's trial.

appearance.text: Tall and bearded, with unusually long arms and brown eyes. As a deserter he is rugged and grim, smelling unwashed and wearing dirty clothes and old armour with its insignia obscured.

personality.text: Hardened by war and desertion, Vathah is blunt, mistrustful, suspicious of lighteyes and often answers with grunts. He belittles those of his men who believe they can be honourable again.
The Lightweavers of the Unseen Court, many of them former deserters from his band, become a close-knit group, and Vathah values having found something like a family.
Even after he comes to respect Shallan, he never quite fits into ordinary society: he stays dark, taciturn and hard to read, and won't talk about his past.
